line: Twelve years of wind and solar stacked as real plates, spiralling round a walnut dial until solar overtakes.
line_cn: 十二年风电和太阳能装机叠成实物，绕表盘升成两条螺旋，2021 年太阳能反超。

camera.move: Macro dolly along a stack's edge, rack focus
camera.expresses: the unit is real and countable
camera.serves: the rule "1 piece = X"; a single record

camera.move: Low lateral track along the series
camera.serves: a decade; a ranking; a sequence of sites

camera.move: Locked three-quarter frame on two subjects
camera.serves: before/after; A against B; a crossover
one year's increase; a target being reached
a summary; a ratio; an ending

transitions: Transitions are camera moves inside one set (one continuous take where possible);
no cuts to a chart, no wipes, no page turns.
labels: Roles: a light grotesk for numbers (e.g. Inter 200–300; the hero reading 130–170 px, a stack reading 46–56 px); a sans for labels and verdicts in the film's language (e.g. Noto Sans SC 500, 24–46 px); a monospace for units, years and source lines (20–24 px); a serif only for the title. OFL, self-hosted, CJK subset.

A reading = a dot on the object, a 1.4 px leader, a small swatch of the series' material, the category line, then the value and unit, on a translucent paper plate (~84 %). Two readings of one pair stack in one column, larger value on top.

The source line (dataset, publisher, year, licence, e.g. "数据：IRENA (2026)，经 Our World in Data 整理 · CC BY 4.0") is in frame with the data, small (20–22 px, ink at ~60 %) in a corner away from the subtitles, at least from the first reading to the summary, and on the title card.
A verdict sits in the upper-left third on its own plate in the accent colour, underlined by a growing rule; it appears only after the readings it judges have been still for ≥ 2.5 s.
motion: On ones, 24 fps; the camera never stops (2–5 % creep on holds).
Cascade: a stack assembles bottom-to-top in 0.5–1.0 s, each piece dropping a few centimetres with an ease-out.

Feed: one period's increase arrives piece by piece from out of frame, quintic ease-out, a yaw that unwinds ("placed", not "dropped"), 8–16 pieces per second, the counter rolling with the pieces landed.
A single heavy object falls with gravity, lands with one small damped bounce, its shadow tightening.

native_moves.name: The unit close-up
native_moves.does: Push into the side of a stack until one piece fills the frame; bracket one piece ("= 10 GW") and one ruler piece ("= 100 GW").
native_moves.fits: tonnes of CO₂ as steel plates; a budget as banknote bricks; a population as wooden discs.

native_moves.name: The paired climb
native_moves.does: Two series on one base, one material each, built year by year as the camera tracks; the crossover is held still with both readings before the verdict.
native_moves.fits: imports vs exports; renewables vs fossil capacity; two companies' revenue.

native_moves.name: The feed
native_moves.does: One period's increase arrives piece by piece onto last period's level, the counter rolling with the landings.
native_moves.fits: this year's new hires on last year's team; a quarter's sales; a record harvest.

native_moves.name: Chart to installation
native_moves.does: Pull back until the bars are a dial, a skyline or a table piece; the base's inlaid marks become its typography.
native_moves.fits: twelve months as a clock; regions as a map-shaped base; product lines as a city.

native_moves.name: The last object
native_moves.does: One single heavier piece (a brass puck, a coin, a weight) lands on the base carrying the final number engraved.
native_moves.fits: a total; a ratio; a target met.

score.note: mallets and air: marimba ostinato, glass, pulse bass; accelerate by subdivision
